channel.description: Threats abound everywhere across the cybersecurity landscape! The ThreatReel Podcast digs deep into the threats impacting enterprise environments and home networks. Join us as we discuss the latest information security news around threats including the actors, the hunting, the intelligence, the modeling, and beyond!

item.title: 2021 RSA Conference Preview | ThreatReel S01E02
item.description: In this episode of ThreatReel, hosts Matt Scheurer and Micah Brown discuss attending RSA and getting the most out of attending a security or hacker conference.

item.title: HAFNIUM, Then and Now | ThreatReel S01E01
item.description: In this episode of ThreatReel, hosts Matt Scheurer and Micah Brown discuss HAFNIUM. Topics include details around the original Microsoft Exchange vulnerabilities and malicious web shell exploits, mitigation strategies, indicators of compromise, threat hunting strategies, and file integrity monitoring. Discussions then shift towards Microsoft Defender ATP mitigations, and the FBI exploiting vulnerabilities to currently compromised mail servers to clean them of unwanted web shells.
